lines: Rinka-senpai's super-hard knuckles aimed directly at the soldiers' weak spots and knocked them down one by one.
She was living up to her name as the "Demon Fist Taimanin," as countless soldiers and several multi-legged tanks had already collapsed all around Rinka-senpai. And yet...
There's too many of them! I can't take them all out alone!
More soldiers kept appearing, no matter how many of them she defeated. They must have been calling in reinforcements.
I would have helped her, but I had my hands full with protecting Saya.
(I'm sure Hebiko and Shikanosuke will notice with all this ruckus. But even if those two get here, what will we do about this army...?)
Hey, onii-chan, get out of the way for a bit.
Saya slowly stepped towards the soldiers.
Are you giving up? Good choice. If you surrender quietly, we'll let those Taimanin go.
What are you still hesitating for?! Get over here already!
Even with the muzzle of countless guns aimed at her, Saya was completely calm.
You're lying. You're definitely going to kill those two, aren't you?
I'm not lying. We were told by Hestia-sama to be lenient with the Taimanin.
Come on, get over here! Hurry up! If you don't, we're gonna send out that pain signal again!
Saya took one step towards the soldiers. But the next moment...
The soldier was pierced by Saya's tentacle right through his entire powered exoskeleton.
Th-That can't be... Why's it not wor-...?
You didn't notice? Thanks to this onee-chan here, all the speakers sending out that sound were destroyed.
One after another, the armored soldiers collapsed to the floor after getting pierced by Saya. The morale of the troops was broken in an instant.
Ahaha! So weak!!! Hey, did you know? Being weak is a sin!!
Seeing her like that sent a chill down my spine.
(No time to be afraid! We can't afford not to take advantage of this opportunity!)
I hurled myself into one group of the scared soldiers and knocked several of them unconscious.
(Alright, let's break through here and make a run for itー)
What a bunch of slackers! You should know Saya NEO's power by now!
I found only the muzzles of more guns waiting for me. With the worst timing possible, more enemy reinforcements had arrived.
I managed to barely evade the gunfire by using a technique I had learned in class.
Just then, a demon fist came flying and smashed into the soldiers from the side. Rinka-senpai had helped me out.
I jumped over the collapsed soldiers and broke through the encirclement, butー
A new powered exoskeleton blocked my way.
(Just as Saya said, looks like they plan to eliminate us too.)
With an unpleasant metallic sound, its giant muzzle aimed at me.
Just in time. Using her tentacles like a spring, Saya jumped towards me with great vigor.
Her impact threw me several meters back and allowed me to dodge the bullets, but thenー
Instead of me, the rain of bullets hit Saya's body.
Suddenly, a black liquid splashed across the face of the powered exoskeleton.
Having lost its vision, the exoskeleton wildly fired its gun, the stray bullets causing several of his allies to collapse.
Hebiko!! Good job with that ink!
F-Fuma! That was close! I thought you were gonna die!!
There was no chance to intervene, so he and Hebiko were biding our time!
We've been watching for a while now, but why did the target protect you, Fuma!?
The target. Our mission was to eliminate Saya.
(If we killed her here our mission would be over and "G" most likely wouldn't come after us. Butー)
What are you thinking about, Fuma-chan?! Let's get out of here already!!
Hebiko looked puzzled, but when she saw Saya sitting in a puddle of her own blood, she nodded, picked her up with her octopus tentacles, and carried her on her back.
ーGot it! But Hebiko won't be able to fight anymore!
We just have to get out of here! Shikanosuke!
Shikanosuke turned towards the confused soldiers and unleashed his Electric Jutsu.
Shikanosuke's electricity disrupted the night vision goggles and other equipment the soldiers were relying on for their vision, blinding them for a moment. Plusー
A golden flash of light knocked down the soldiers and opened up a path in front of us.
Madam wasn't sure if you guys alone would manage, so I came on her request!
It's not like I was worried or anything! Come on, let's get out of here!
Rinka-senpai! There's an opening over here! Let's go!
And like that, we escaped the surrounding UFS "G" forces and made it to the city.
There Asuka was waiting for us. She must have been sent by the masked woman.
I didn't expect you to bring her with you. Even if you are a Taimanin, I guess asking you to eliminate her was a bit too much for a student...
You've done enough, we'll take care of the rest. Hand over the girl.
No, I don't plan on handing her over.
Yeah. We're not going to eliminate her. We'll take her back to Gosha with us.
Haa... Hebiko had a feeling you would say that.
That girl got hurt protecting you, didn't she, Fuma-chan?
And Fuma-chan isn't such an accomplished Taimanin who can simply kill a girl after she saved his life, just because it's a mission.
Hebiko was right. I had seen Saya as a normal girl and didn't have it in me to kill her.
But there was one more reason.
(She was created as a demon. And my resurrection was also due to my demonic power. Judging her as dangerous and eliminating her just for that is a bit...)
What are you planning, Fuma? Are you going to go against the request?
I'm not planning to go completely against it. We just have to make sure that the technology from the Devildom doesn't get leaked to the public, right?
Don't just change the request based on your interpretation. Hurry up and hand over the target already.
Then I guess we'll have to take her from you by force!
Even though I helped you that much, you really are stupid.
A menacing aura could be felt from Asuka and Akitsu.
Their strength was on another level. Although there were four of us, we still weren't as strong as them, and we were also carrying the wounded Saya.
Fuma, I'll hold them off. Take the girl and run.
No time to hesitate. Make sure to explain everything to Headmistress Asagi!
Certainly, rather than all four of us fighting here, it was better to have Rinka, the only one comparable in power to them, stall them here.
We said our thanks to Rinka-senpai and started running immediately.
I won't let you go after them. You will have to deal with me first, you two.
I've had enough of Taimanin! Why can't you just do what you've been asked to!?
He must have a reason. You two are fighting for a reason as well, aren't you?
Hmph. Do you think a human like you can slow us down?
If I didn't think I could, I would've run away long ago. Alright, come on!
